subject: Risk & Compliance
title: Minority Shareholder Protections
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Minority Shareholder Protections.

hook.text: A controlling shareholder pushes through a deal that benefits them but hurts everyone else. You can't stop it.

buildup.text: Minority shareholders own too few votes to block decisions. They rely on legal protections and board oversight.

discovery.text: Delaware law requires 'entire fairness' in related-party transactions where insiders benefit.

twist.text: In many countries, minority protections are weak. Controlling families extract value with impunity.

climax.text: Strong minority protections attract investment. Weak ones concentrate wealth at the top.

punchline.text: Minority shareholders need protection. Not every system provides it.

quiz.question: What does the 'entire fairness' standard protect?
